I have a decision regarding decision making. 3793 views Q. Assalaamu alaikum wa rahmatullah, Dear Sheikh, I pray to Allah SWT that you are enjoying a good health & high Islamic spirit. (1) It has come to my knowledge that some people observe certain nawwafil salaah by reciting any specific surah a certain number of times( that is more than once) in each raka'ah after reading surah faati'ha. Sometimes they would make an extra sajdah after reading the tashahhud & darood and there, they would ask for any specific doah they are in need for. They would even call this salah as haajaat. However I have not cross of any of this kind of salaah in the ahadeeth. Could you please enlighten me on this. (2) My second question is about those 'aamil who after asking someone's name & mother's name, claim that they make istikhaarah salah in order to find out if that person is under the influence of jiin or evil eyes etc. As far as i understand, Istikhaarah salaah is accomplished when someone is unsure of whether doing something is good for him/her or not. But what I don't understand is how Istikhaarah salaah can help someone to find out the malady of someone else. Would that not be more appropriate to offer haajah salaah in this context? I look forward to your valuable views and comments on the above two issues Incha Allah. I thank you in anticipation for your cooperation. Wassalaam. 2469 views Q. answer: Miscellaneous >> Dua (Supplications) Question ID: 23347 Country: India Title: Did nabi peace be on him recite surah muzamil evry nite? What is the virtue of this surah? What is the fazilat of reciting surah fajr in the morning? Question: Assalamoalaikum. Did nabi peace be on him recite surah muzamil evry nite? What is the virtue of this surah? What is the fazilat of reciting surah fajr in the morning? JazakAllah hu khaira. Wassalamu alaik Answer ID: 23347 Posted on: Sep 1, 2020 Bismillah hir-Rahman nir-Rahim ! (Fatwa: 1301/1301/M=1431) We could not find any source that the Holy Prophet Muhammad (صلى الله عليه وسلم) recited Surah Muzzammil each night. We do not know any special virtue of this surah as well as the virtue of reciting surah Fajr in the morning. Allah (Subhana Wa Ta'ala) knows Best Darul Ifta, Darul Uloom Deoband, India
